patterns: APPSC asks direct one-liners: Prataparudra's captor = Ulugh Khan (not Kafur/Alauddin); Rayagajakesari = Rudrama for victory over Devagiri Yadavas.
Marco Polo visit dated to Rudramadevi's reign (G2 2011 key); Motupalli port; Prataparudra Yashobhushanam = Vidyanatha.
First Muslim attack on Orugallu = 1303 (repulsed at Upparapalli) is a recurring date trap against 1309-10 Kafur.
Other PSCs ask only dynasty identification (Rudrama = Kakatiya); the app adds many multi-statement items on inscriptions, campaigns and commanders far deeper than PYQs.
